newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Manhattan Bagel cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Manhattan Bagel cut.

text.p: -- Rodman & Renshaw Inc said it downgraded Manhattan Bagel Co to neutral from buy.

-- In a release dated November 15, analyst Ronald Morrow said Q3 1996 sales met expectations but Q3 operating earnings per share were reported at break-even vs estimate of $0.08, due mainly to "continued West Coast operational problems."
-- Last year, Manhattan Bagel earned $0.12 per share in Q3.
-- Analyst lowered 1996 EPS estimate to $0.19 from $0.38 and cut 1997 EPS estimate to $0.35 from $0.63.
-- Manhattan Bagel shares were trading at 7-5/8, down 3/8. --Chicago Newsdesk (3120 408-8787
